newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah falls on regional spillover.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah falls on regional spillover.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah fell against the dollar in early trading on Thursday due to sharp declines in the Malaysian ringgit and the Singapore dollar, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer said early falls of the ringgit and the Singapore dollar spilled over to Jakarta, breaking the crucial 2,600 support level.
Spot rupiah fell to a low of 2,625 against the dollar from 2,580 at the opening. It was quoted at 2,600/10 at 0200 GMT.
Dealers said the market was nervous, watching out for developments in the region.
